title: Conversation & Spoken Markers — Consolidation
goal: Integrate pan-Hispanic discourse markers, spoken excuses, hedges, live retelling and interview stance openers
grammar: Unit 18 review: marcadores-conversacionales, refutacion-no-es-que-sino, subjunctive-doubt, discurso-indirecto-deicticos, stance-adverbs

items: I can organise everyday Spanish talk with pan-Hispanic markers like *pues*, *bueno*, *oiga*, *o sea* and *vamos*.
I can soften excuses with *no es que* + subjunctive, *es que* + indicative and steer a talk back on track.
I can hedge agreement and disagreement with *puede que* + subjunctive vs *a lo mejor* + indicative.
I can retell spoken remarks with accurate time/place pointers and open candid turns with stance expressions.
